hero.title: Behind every difficult behavior there is an emotion asking to be heard.
hero.description: When children face fears, anxiety, or anger, they do not always have the words to tell us what hurts. They show it through behavior, crying, withdrawal, or repeated refusals.
hero.description2: The parent in you feels that helplessness and looks for a way to communicate. I am here to guide you and rediscover calm together.
hero.bio: My name is Valeria Maria Stănculea and I am a clinical psychologist and integrative psychotherapist specialized in child therapy, accredited by the Romanian College of Psychologists. Beyond credentials and diplomas, I am a warm ally for your child’s inner world and real support for you as a parent.
hero.closing: In my practice, there is no judgment, only space for healing, gentleness, and mutual understanding.
hero.imageAlt: Valeria Maria Stănculea - Child & Family Psychologist Bucharest

services.title: Services dedicated to your family’s emotional balance
services.subtitle: Every stage of growth comes with its own challenges. That is why my approach is tailored to each age and family dynamic.

evaluation.title: Play Therapy (4 - 10 years)
evaluation.description: Play is children’s native language, and toys are their words. I use guided Play Therapy techniques to help children express and process fear, anger, or anxiety in a safe way.

therapy.title: Psychotherapy for Adolescents
therapy.description: A period of intense change, social pressure, and identity search. I offer a fully confidential space where adolescents can speak freely about anxiety, self-esteem, school stress, or relationships.

counseling.title: Parent Counseling & Family Therapy
counseling.description: There is no manual for the perfect parent, but you can be the parent your child needs. We work as a team to understand children’s reactions and implement warm strategies based on kindness and healthy limits.

about.title: About My Approach
about.description1: As a clinical psychologist and integrative psychotherapist, I work with children, adolescents and families using an approach that combines cognitive, emotional and behavioral components.
about.description2: Play therapy is the central modality for exploration and regulation in working with children, and family involvement is an integral part of the support and change process.

pricing.subtitle: Flexible options adapted to your child and family's needs.
pricing.disclaimer: Rates are indicative. Exact details are discussed at the first consultation.

items.q: How do I book an appointment?
items.a: You can contact me by email or through the contact form. I will respond within 24 hours to schedule an appointment.
Yes, research shows online therapy is as effective as in-person therapy for most psychological issues in children and adolescents.

items.q: What age children do you work with?
items.a: I work with children from age 3 and up, adolescents, and families. The approach is adapted to age and specific needs.
Please notify me at least 24 hours in advance if you cannot attend. Late cancellations are partially charged.

items.q: What languages do you offer services in?
items.a: I offer services in Romanian, English, Italian, and Spanish, both in-person and online.
